context: You arrive in Baldur’s Gate just after the assault on the Stronghold; Refugee 06 has been misrouted to the city camp by a logistical error and is loudly venting their frustration about how refugees are being treated. The city is tense: small anti‑refugee demonstrations (led by agitator Saer Grotpoll) have sprung up while a Flaming Fist constable tries to keep order and Halsin opposes the protesters. Off‑screen you carry the aftermath of the Stronghold—Netherstone in hand and allies being gathered—so how you respond here carries weight beyond this brief civic scene. Nearby civic tensions also touch the local clergy: the head priest was recently killed, and remaining priests are arguing about whether he’d been too welcoming to refugees.
